_about: Site value checker settings (scripts/hq/value.py → hq/value.json, shown in IMN HQ → Value). Estimates, not offers. Benchmarks checked 21 Nov 2026: Flippa's commonly cited 30–45x monthly profit; Flippa H1 2026 actual average 2.32x annual profit (~28x monthly), top quartile 4.68x annual (~56x monthly). We use 25–45x monthly profit and move within it per site. Revenue and costs come from hq/finance.json: revenue[] entries need month (YYYY-MM), amount (A$), site (a site id from hq/sitecheck.json, its brand, or lab:<slug>) and source (adsense, affiliate:<programme>, sponsor…).
_worthSelling: Simon's 'worth selling' number (A$, the low end of the value range). null = not set yet; the flag stays off until he sets it.
_handsOff: Sites that run on autopilot (CLAUDE.md). Buyers pay more for hands-off running.
_emailList: Subscribers per site id, e.g. { "vic": 120 }. A list of 100+ nudges the multiple up. Update when Simon checks D1.
_backlinks: Referring domains per site id, e.g. { "vic": 12 }. 10+ nudges the multiple up.
